zh-CN.title: 修复未解锁背景预览
items: 修复部分高等级聊天背景点击后未显示在预览场景中的问题
尚未解锁的背景仍可预览，保存时继续校验解锁条件

en.title: Fixed locked background previews
items: Fixed some higher-level chat backgrounds not appearing in the preview after selection
Locked backgrounds remain previewable while unlock requirements are still enforced when saving
